queries: WITH t AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: A project's tally under a status is the number of distinct projects (arcref) with at least one QC record in that status. A project with QC records in several statuses is counted in each of them, so the tallies can sum to more than the number of projects.
A missing status means a NULL archstat, and NULL forms its own group. Empty strings are not treated as missing.
The average share is the mean of the per-status shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of status groups, including the NULL group. The excess is share minus that average, with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: The tally is the number of QC records per status, not distinct projects.

assumptions.assumption: Tallying projects means counting distinct projects (arcref) per archival status. A project with QC rows under several statuses is counted once in each, and the share denominator is the sum of these per-status tallies.
A NULL archstat is its own group (GROUP BY keeps NULLs together), and it is included when computing the average share.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares. 'How far above' is the plain difference share minus average share, unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Tally is the number of QC records per status (each scanqc row counts as one), rather than distinct projects.

assumptions.assumption: 'Tally the projects' means the count of distinct projects (arcref) per archstat. A project with QC rows in several statuses is counted once in each of those statuses.
A NULL archstat forms its own group. The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares, which includes the NULL group.
The share denominator is the sum of the per-status tallies, as the request says. It is not the overall count of distinct projects.

alternatives.interpretation: Tally means the number of QC records (rows) per archival status, not distinct projects.
